test_rule: For trace-zero x use lambda=half_trace(x), check lambda^2+lambda=x, and evaluate the four-divisibility character Tr(y+(lambda+1)x). Compare that bit with the extracted quadratic on all 16384 pair sample points and all 8192 curve controls. Check rP for all 256 seed points, Q, and the first 256 control points. Verify Tr(z)=bit0 for every field basis vector.
claim_boundary: Cofactor classification of the N41 quadratic gate on frozen sampled points and all seed points. Full prefix rejection is measured separately; the algebraic four-divisibility formula has a group-law proof.
